homepage.title.message: China map components for React Native

homepage.tagline.message: A React Native map library for China, API-compatible with react-native-maps

homepage.meta.message: AMap · Baidu · Tencent · Huawei Map Kit ｜ iOS · Android · HarmonyOS Next ｜ New Architecture (Fabric)

feature.parity.desc.message: MapView, Marker, Callout, Polyline, Polygon, Circle, Overlay, tile layers, Heatmap, Geojson — the full set. Most migrations are a one-line import change.

feature.providers.desc.message: AMap / Baidu / Tencent / Huawei ship as separate packages. Core and provider adapters are decoupled, so unused SDKs never enter your bundle.

feature.coordinate.desc.message: Declare your input system (wgs84 / gcj02 / bd09); the library converts to the selected provider's native system in JS. No more offset drift.

feature.harmony.desc.message: iOS, Android, and HarmonyOS Next via RNOH. Pure Fabric components + TurboModule, no legacy bridge.

feature.privacy.desc.message: The library never auto-agrees to a privacy policy. The host app declares consent explicitly per PIPL, satisfying app-store review.

feature.native.desc.message: Gradient polylines, ground image overlays, heatmaps, custom tiles, KML/GeoJSON — mapped straight onto each native SDK.
